brief:
Israeli settlers stormed the al-Harayeq area of Beita, south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, and attacked the home of Palestinian citizen Mutie Salim Qutish, according to Middle East Eye. The incident occurred as settlers also targeted olive harvesters in the vicinity.

No further details on casualties, damage, or the identity of those involved in the assault were immediately available.

title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinian home in West Bank
